name: a dashboard card builds its numbers and chart live
looks: A dark analytics card holds three headline numbers side by side, then a green line chart draws across underneath, picking up speed toward the end. Small toast notifications slide in from the right one at a time, each naming a fresh result as it lands.
build: The three numbers roll up on a short stagger; the line draws with strokeDashoffset on power3.out, a dot riding its tip; each toast slides/fades in from the right on its own beat and holds before the next one arrives.
sound: A rising tone under the chart draw and a soft pop on each toast landing.
prompt: Build a dark analytics card live: three headline numbers rolling up side by side, a line chart drawing across underneath with a dot riding its tip, and a couple of small toast notifications sliding in from the edge one at a time to name fresh results as they land.
